rows.quote: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍会将部分吸收的伤害施加给附近多个敌人。

rows.quote: When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.
rows.reason_zh: 基础护盾破裂时仍会对周围区域造成伤害。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 对友军施放基础护盾时仍施加强驱散。

rows.quote: an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring
rows.reason_zh: 基础护盾仍能吸收一定数额的各类伤害。

rows.quote: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 吸收伤害由基础护盾提供，魔晶提供的是按已吸收伤害对敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier
rows.reason_zh: 技能在已有友军身上生成护盾，没有召唤有血量的单位或夺取单位控制权。

rows.quote: ability_has_scepter: true→false
rows.reason_zh: 回光返照的 A 杖升级已移除，因此原行关于 A 杖不提供范围伤害的否定判断仍成立。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能发动时仍会对自身施加强驱散。

rows.quote: Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
rows.reason_zh: 破坏仍能阻止被动自动发动，材料也未列出 IsBreakable 变更。

rows.quote: all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm
rows.reason_zh: 技能生效期间，受到的伤害会转为治疗，从而防止亚巴顿被这些伤害击杀。

rows.quote: all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍将受到的伤害转为自身治疗。

rows.quote: ability_has_scepter: true→false
rows.reason_zh: 回光返照已无 A 杖升级，因此 A 杖不提供缠绕的原判仍成立。

rows.quote: effect_radius.base: []→[0]
rows.reason_zh: 基础作用半径为 0，只有 A 杖把效果扩展到目标周围，基础范围伤害的否定判断仍成立。

rows.quote: Friendly units are healed and have their movement speed increased.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能对友军仍有治疗效果。

rows.quote: Enemy units are damaged and slowed.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍可选中敌方单位施加伤害和减速，A 杖扩大的是目标周围的作用范围。

new_mechanisms.quote: Friendly units are healed and have their movement speed increased.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42 为基础技能命中的友军新增移动速度加成。

new_mechanisms.quote: Enemy units are damaged and slowed.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42 为基础技能命中的敌人新增移动减速。

new_mechanisms.quote: Mist Coil affects all units in a %effect_radius% radius around the target.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 新增 A 杖升级使技能能伤害目标周围 400 范围内的多个敌人，现有否定行仅适用于基础技能。

rows.quote: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击把诅咒施加给被击中的敌人，本次调整没有使伤害波及周围单位。

rows.quote: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍会附加造成减速和持续伤害的诅咒。

rows.quote: curse_duration.base: [2]→[3]
rows.reason_zh: 本次调整涉及诅咒时长、伤害及攻速等字段，未列出 IsBreakable 变更，沿用原行的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them
rows.reason_zh: 7.42 仍明确写有诅咒减速，删除单独的 slow_duration 字段没有删除该效果。

rows.quote: Damaging enemies reduces their Health Restoration for %duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 受到伤害是敌人被减疗的触发条件，凋零迷雾本身没有新增对多个敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: max_heal_reduction_pct.base: null→[40]
rows.reason_zh: 改动调整了减疗强度及触发条件，未列出 IsBreakable 变更，沿用原行的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: The lower the enemy's HP, the stronger the Health restoration reduction effect.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍削减生命恢复，强度从满血时的 10% 随生命降低而增至最高 40%，物品伤害不能触发。

rows.quote: chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage
rows.reason_zh: 重击的额外伤害仍施加给本次攻击目标，主动技能也只指向一个敌人。

rows.quote: Passive: Bash Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%%% chance on hit to stun the target
rows.reason_zh: 符合条件的英雄攻击命中时仍有概率触发重击，新说明明确幻象不能获得该重击。

rows.quote: Active: Overwhelm Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds. Pierces Debuff Immunity.
rows.reason_zh: 7.42 的装备效果和字段变更均未新增伤害格挡，旧版关于格挡不叠加的通用注释也已删除。

rows.quote: Active: Overwhelm Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds. Pierces Debuff Immunity.
rows.reason_zh: 装备主动技能仍明确无视减益免疫。

rows.quote: slow_resistance.base: [30]→null
rows.reason_zh: 装备原有的 30% 减速抗性已移除。

rows.quote: Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 装备主动技能仍能眩晕指定敌人。

rows.quote: chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 被动重击触发时仍会眩晕攻击目标。

rows.quote: Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍具备眩晕机制，主动施法距离调整没有移除眩晕。

rows.quote: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals.
rows.reason_zh: 原行所对应的怨念深渊仍由 A 杖在远端门生成，生成地点从两处减为一处，范围伤害判定仍成立。

rows.quote: Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side.
rows.reason_zh: 需要引导的是英雄使用传送门的过程，孽主开门本身没有持续施法要求。

rows.quote: Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side.
rows.reason_zh: 其他英雄仍可自行引导穿门，由传送门将其送到另一端。

rows.quote: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals.
rows.reason_zh: A 杖仍在固定的门周围生成怨念深渊场地，现在仅在远端门生成。

rows.quote: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals.
rows.reason_zh: 原行认定提供缠绕的怨念深渊仍在远端门生成，适用条件仍为 A 杖。

rows.quote: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
rows.reason_zh: 自身传送由基础传送门提供，A 杖改动没有额外提供孽主自身位移。

rows.quote: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
rows.reason_zh: 孽主仍能通过基础技能传送自身。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 新增 A 杖弹体字段给出 40% 的移动减速和 2.5 秒的持续时间。
新增 A 杖弹体字段给出 100 的视野范围和 1.5 秒的视野持续时间。

rows.reason_zh: 本次变更将减伤改为护盾并调整持续时间，未列出 IsBreakable 变更，沿用原行的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: they temporarily gain a Physical Damage Barrier based on their max health
rows.reason_zh: 传送后的百分比减伤改为按友军最大生命值计算的物理伤害护盾，仍符合伤害吸收机制。

rows.quote: they temporarily gain a Physical Damage Barrier based on their max health and Movement Speed.
rows.reason_zh: 友方英雄传送后仍会获得临时移动速度加成。

rows.quote: After an allied hero Teleports
rows.reason_zh: 传送是获得增益的前置事件，该技能本身没有提供位移。

rows.quote: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain a Physical Damage Barrier based on their max health and Movement Speed.
rows.reason_zh: 移速效果作用于传送后的友军，没有对敌人施加减速。

rows.quote: item_cost: 2275→2100；cast_range_bonus.base: [225]→[200]
rows.reason_zh: 本次仅改动价格与施法距离，没有改变原行所记的装备回蓝属性。

rows.quote: applying a basic dispel
rows.reason_zh: 药剂施放时仍对友军施加弱驱散，dispellable 字段的变化描述的是药剂效果自身的可驱散性。

rows.quote: giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen
rows.reason_zh: 药剂仍为友军提高移动速度，本次材料未显示原行的魔晶获取条件发生变化。

rows.quote: giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen
rows.reason_zh: 药剂仍给予友军生命恢复。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42 改变了药剂增益自身的可驱散规则，材料未给出枚举值 3 对应的驱散等级。

rows.quote: scepter_bonus_damage.base: [15]→[20]
rows.reason_zh: 唯一字段改动是熔化 A 杖的攻击力奖励，IsBreakable 未列为变化字段，沿用原行的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes.
rows.reason_zh: 击杀与赏金神符仍可为炼金术士提供额外金钱。

rows.quote: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy Hero with his abilities its Strength is reduced.
rows.reason_zh: 技能魔法伤害触发力量削减，刺骨严寒本身没有新增范围伤害。

rows.quote: movement_slow_pct.base: [2]→[]
rows.reason_zh: 本次仅列出减速字段变更，未列出 IsBreakable 变更，沿用原行关于不可被破坏的判断。

rows.quote: movement_slow_pct.base: [2]→[]
rows.reason_zh: 原有减速数值被清空，7.42 说明也删除了减速，仅保留对敌方英雄的力量削减。

rows.quote: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
rows.reason_zh: 强化攻击仍附加魔法伤害与减速。

rows.quote: a burst of magical damage and slow
rows.reason_zh: 基础强化攻击仍会减速命中的目标。

rows.quote: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
rows.reason_zh: 本次调整了伤害和魔耗，未改变原行所记的敌方单位指向方式。

rows.quote: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
rows.reason_zh: 基础施法仍对一个敌人施加诅咒，范围点目标施法仍由原有命石说明单独提供。

rows.quote: If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 目标未及时离开初始位置周围的范围时，仍会被眩晕。

rows.quote: Places a curse on an enemy
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍以一个敌方单位为施法目标。

new_mechanisms.quote: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42 为基础诅咒新增移动减速，各级数值为 4%、6%、8%、10%。

rows.quote: the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail
rows.reason_zh: 基础爆炸仍能伤害区域内的多个敌人，各级伤害调整后均大于 0。

rows.quote: If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
rows.reason_zh: 受冻单位生命低于阈值时仍会被直接击杀，说明保留了幻象例外。

rows.quote: taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing
rows.reason_zh: 受冻敌人仍会被禁止进行大多数形式的生命恢复。

rows.quote: prevented from regenerating or healing
rows.reason_zh: 技能施加的是对生命恢复的限制，没有给单位恢复生命。

rows.quote: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍会按当前寒霜之足眩晕时长的一定比例冻结命中的敌人。

rows.quote: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
rows.reason_zh: 漩涡仍对范围内的多个敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.
rows.reason_zh: 漩涡仍提供放置地点周围小范围的视野。

rows.quote: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
rows.reason_zh: 漩涡仍在放置地点持续影响范围内的敌人。
各级减抗幅度降低，但范围内敌人仍会受到更多魔法伤害。

rows.quote: movement_speed_pct.base: [-8]→[-10,-15,-20,-25]
rows.reason_zh: 减速从固定 8% 改为随等级增强，各级仍会降低敌人移速。

rows.quote: disables their passives
rows.reason_zh: 装备强化的下一次敌方单位指向技能仍会使目标的被动失效。

rows.quote: Passive: Empower Spell
rows.reason_zh: 两版被动说明相同且没有字段变更，沿用原行的装备回复判定，所引说明未单列回复属性。

rows.quote: Passive: Empower Spell
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明相同且没有字段变更，沿用原行的装备回蓝判定，所引说明未单列回蓝属性。

rows.quote: slows their movement speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 强化技能命中敌人时仍会降低其移动速度。

rows.quote: The slow debuff is dispellable.
rows.reason_zh: 7.42 仍明确保留可被驱散的减速效果。

rows.quote: deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage
rows.reason_zh: 装备触发的是一次独立额外伤害，没有提高技能本身的伤害倍率。

rows.quote: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
rows.reason_zh: 破坏仍使被动魔法抗性失效，材料也未列出 IsBreakable 变更。

rows.quote: blocks and reflects any targeted spells
rows.reason_zh: 基础护盾在指向技能命中时进行格挡和反弹，没有新增因自身受到伤害而触发的反击伤害。

rows.quote: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶在敌方施法者旁生成碎片，敌法师本体没有发生位移。

rows.quote: an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells
rows.reason_zh: 基础护盾仍可格挡指向敌法师的技能。

rows.quote: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
rows.reason_zh: 反弹由基础护盾提供，魔晶只在成功反弹后生成碎片。

rows.quote: blocks and reflects any targeted spells
rows.reason_zh: 基础护盾仍会反弹指向技能。

rows.quote: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击仍附带烧蓝和按烧蓝量计算的伤害。

rows.quote: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明相同且无字段变更，沿用原行依据 IsBreakable 作出的可被破坏判定。

rows.quote: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击仍会削减对手的法力。

rows.quote: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
rows.reason_zh: 伤害仍按主目标法力计算，并施加给范围内的所有敌人。

rows.quote: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明相同且无字段变更，沿用原行关于基础技能不可被破坏的判定。

rows.quote: The main target is also mini-stunned.
rows.reason_zh: 主目标仍会受到小眩晕。

rows.quote: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 施法仍以一个敌方单位为主目标，伤害同时波及其周围敌人。
